newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta bourse suspends trading in Mas.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta bourse suspends trading in Mas.

text.p: The Jakarta Stock Exchange suspended small property firm Mas Murni Indonesia on Wednesday morning but trading will resume in the afternoon session, officials said.
"We suspended the trading in Mas Murni for the morning session as we were waiting for company's explanation after its share price jumped on Tuesday," one bourse official said.
On Tuesday, Mas Murni Indonesia rose 175 rupiah to close at 825 rupiah on a sudden spurt of active buying near the close due to market talk of a possible take-over, brokers said.
The official said the exchange will resume trading in the counter after midsession as the company later submitted a letter saying it knew of no factors which could affect its share price.
"In their letter, the company also said that it is now considering a rights issue. They are still discussing it with the Stock Exchange Supervisory Agency," the official said.
The official gave no further details.
